def.brief: Write the tests for the owner's strict-declaration clarification into test_dwitbuk.py (this project's free-function suite: module-level test_Q_strict_... functions, its Project harness and write/run/git helpers, collected by the file's own __main__ runner). A bare record entry is an exact FILE path; a trailing-slash entry is a directory; nothing is inferred from the disk. Cover: is_record (hunsu.json/child.py and hunsu.json/ are not records of the bare hunsu.json; custom-record.json/child.py of a lock-declared bare custom-record.json; directory entries unchanged). On real git output, in a project where hunsu.json and a lock-declared custom-record.json were each committed as files, then replaced by directories holding a committed child.py that is then changed: the eyes request's diff holds both child.py changes and an untracked file inside such a directory is in new_files; verify_packet keeps them in touched with their diff; eyes consume refuses with 'source changed' after child.py changes; the stop hook's touched and packet diff hold them; documents_or_records says they are not records; a project without git walks into such a directory. Also: diff_leaves_out keeps declared entries as declared (directories with trailing /) and the packet directory as '<rel>/'; when only records changed the eyes request's diff is empty; verify_packet diffs a touched x[1].json literally (a changed x1.json is not in its diff). Amend, do not delete, the earlier assertions this clarification supersedes (bare alpha.json covering alpha.json/inner.txt and alpha.json/, bare mangsang covering mangsang/relations/R-1.json, and diff_leaves_out sets written without trailing slashes, including test_eyes_packet_carries_diff_records_plan_and_open_findings_and_consume_keeps_only_quoted_contradictions). Keep mangsang/ late-review behaviour and same-prefix / wildcard literal cases as they are. Red evidence is the real suite: python3 test_dwitbuk.py, or a focused python3 -c 'import test_dwitbuk as t; t.test_Q_strict_x()'; python3 -m unittest collects nothing here. No mutation campaign is needed. Change no file but test_dwitbuk.py; do not commit.

non-claims: no check decides this task; done means the agent said so

(provider) Behaviour that has not changed (directory entries, same-prefix neighbours, literal wildcards, empty entries) cannot fail on its own today. It is asserted inside tests that also check a new part of the contract, so each test still fails now, rather than as one test per unchanged sentence.

(provider) 'Pathspec magic alone is not a correct exclusion' and 'never an unrestricted git diff': no test watches the git argv. They are decided only by output: a changed hunsu.json/child.py must appear in the diff, and an eyes request where only records changed must have diff == ''.

(provider) 'Each touched path and each excluded path is given to git as a literal pathspec (:(literal)PATH)': this is decided only by the x[1].json / x1.json output test. A different way of escaping that selects only x[1].json would also pass.

(provider) 'No stat and no other look at the disk': the test runs is_record from a working directory where hunsu.json and alpha.json are directories. It does not patch os.stat, so a lookup that ignores its result would go unseen.

(provider) The stop-hook test enables stop-eyes through the lock's settings and hunsu.local.json, because hunsu.json is a directory in that fixture. It assumes the hook reads at least one of those sources, as README.md says it does.
(provider) The untracked/ignored-directory test assumes source_state examines git-ignored directory entries, as Q-strict-sites 3 says ('an untracked or ignored directory entry from git status').

(provider) 'python3 test_dwitbuk.py passes as a whole on Python 3.11 or later': tests were run only on Python 3.12, and the pre-existing failure of test_session_start_hook_says_what_the_placed_reviews_still_need_and_nothing_else (JSONDecodeError) is outside this contract and was left alone.
(provider) 'No version bump; README.md, the manifests, eyes_worker.py and hostcall.py are not part of this build': no test checks this.
